entities.name: Ingeborg Wærn Bugge
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ingeborg Wærn Bugge was a Swedish architect. She was one of the first formally educated female architects in Sweden. She designed residential buildings and schools, and worked on renovation projects for churches.
